findings.location: Proof step 7.3: "every U intersection St(tau) ... is convex"
findings.evidence: Historical defect in independently read and hashed pre-reader bytes. A small intrinsic ball around the common vertex of two edges intersects that vertex's star in two edge segments, a nonconvex union. Convexity inside individual simplices does not establish convexity of the whole star intersection. The internal-Hom calculation needed explicit acyclicity and shrinking compatibility. Current replacement step 6.4 uses intersections with individual closed simplices and verifies compatibility. This finding concerns the pre snapshot.

findings.location: Proof step 6.2: cone bound from H^r(F;k)=0 for 1<=r<=R
